description: HydraShield Research Registry — peer-reviewed and authoritative scientific foundations. A paper never becomes production logic directly: it moves through Paper → Method → Prototype → Benchmark → Validation → Production. Production methodologies (config/model_registry.json) reference these entries via research_ids.

references.title: Development and structure of the Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index System
references.venue: Canadian Forestry Service, Forestry Technical Report 35
references.method: Empirical moisture-code/fire-behaviour index system (FFMC/DMC/DC/ISI/BUI/FWI) from daily noon weather
references.region: Canada; applied internationally with declared adaptations
references.limitations: Noon-standard daily inputs; fuel-specific calibration; not a probability of ignition

references.title: A mathematical model for predicting fire spread in wildland fuels
references.venue: USDA Forest Service Research Paper INT-115
references.method: Surface-fire spread model from fuel properties, wind and slope
references.region: United States; applied widely with fuel-model adaptations
references.limitations: Steady-state surface fire; not crown fire; fuel-bed description required

references.title: Standard fire behavior fuel models: a comprehensive set for use with Rothermel's surface fire spread model
references.method: 40 standard fuel models for Rothermel-style spread computation
references.region: United States; proxy use elsewhere declared
references.limitations: Fuel-model selection drives results; proxy mapping from land cover is approximate

references.title: The ERA5 global reanalysis
references.venue: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society 146(730)
references.method: 4D-Var atmospheric reanalysis (ECMWF IFS Cy41r2), hourly, ~31 km
references.limitations: Model-based reanalysis, not station observation; grid smoothing; ~5-day latency

references.title: GloFAS — global ensemble streamflow forecasting and flood early warning
references.method: Global hydrological modelling (Lisflood) with ensemble forecasting
references.limitations: Modelled discharge, not gauge observation; coarse for small catchments

references.title: The relationship of drought frequency and duration to time scales
references.venue: 8th Conference on Applied Climatology, American Meteorological Society
references.method: Standardized Precipitation Index: gamma-fitted precipitation probabilities standardized per accumulation window
references.limitations: Precipitation-only; gamma fit needs long records; HydraShield currently implements a declared standardized anomaly, NOT full SPI

references.title: A multiscalar drought index sensitive to global warming: The SPEI
references.method: Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index: climatic water balance standardized per window
references.limitations: ET estimation method affects results; not yet implemented in HydraShield

references.title: Future climate risk from compound events
references.method: Conceptual framework for compound event risk under climate change
references.limitations: Framework paper; no operational detection algorithm

references.title: A typology of compound weather and climate events
references.method: Four-class typology: preconditioned, multivariate, temporally compounding, spatially compounding
references.limitations: Typology, not an operational algorithm; HydraShield implements a declared qualitative detector on top

references.title: Collection 6 MODIS active fire detection algorithm and fire products
references.method: Contextual thermal-anomaly detection algorithm; FRP retrieval
references.limitations: Hotspot detections, not fire perimeters; cloud/vegetation obscuration; overpass timing

references.title: WorldPop, open data for spatial demography
references.method: Dasymetric population mapping from census and covariates
references.limitations: Modelled estimates, not counts; reference-year dependent

references.title: IPCC AR6 WG1 — Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis (SPM incl. sea-level projections, Table SPM.1)
references.venue: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, Working Group I
references.method: Assessed literature synthesis; SSP-scenario projections with likely ranges
references.limitations: Scenario-conditional projections; global means require regional downscaling for local use

references.title: IPCC AR6 WG2 — Climate Change 2022: Impacts, Adaptation and Vulnerability (risk framework: hazard × exposure × vulnerability; compound/cascading risk)
references.venue: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, Working Group II
references.method: Risk conceptual framework: risk arises from dynamic interactions of hazard, exposure and vulnerability
references.limitations: Framework, not an operational model; HydraShield operationalizes a declared subset

references.title: ISO 14091:2021 — Adaptation to climate change: guidelines on vulnerability, impacts and risk assessment
references.method: International organizational guideline for climate-risk assessment processes
references.limitations: International STANDARD, not HydraShield proprietary methodology; used as organizational reference only — clearly distinguished from HydraShield indicators
